title: Who is older than Laine: Perkins, Baquet, Gilles Rouge
summary: Laine says the old musicians are all dead; he compares ages with Dave Perkins (seven years older), Baquet (his age) and the piccolo player Gilles Rouge.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
